 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Overlay the two panels; mark cells occupied in both with 2."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Panels separated by a full-height marker column (demo format).
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 7 for r in range(h))]
    if sep_cols:
        c = sep_cols[0]
        left = [row[:c] for row in grid]
        right = [row[c + 1:] for row in grid]
        return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(x, y)]
                for x, y in zip(left, right)]

    # Panels separated by a full-width marker row (test format).
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 3 for v in grid[r])]
    if sep_rows:
        r = sep_rows[0]
        top, bottom = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
        return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(x, y)]
                for x, y in zip(top, bottom)]

    raise ValueError('No panel separator found')
"
